name: In Heart
source:
"I absolutely hate you, Glenn!"

Exclaiming that with full strength, I ran away in front of my butler.
Since, Glenn is quite cruel y’know?
I love him this much, yet he won’t notice my feelings at all.
Rather, instead he always keeps scolding me!

I wonder what Glenn really thinks of me…?
The mysterious traveler who appears before me, who’s at a loss. He’d show me medicine that he’d say would ‘grant a wish’, but…

[Edited from [url=https://koorinokokoro.wordpress.com/2011/09/24/otome-game-review-tics-special/]Koorin's blog[/url]]
translation:
“格伦，我最讨厌你！”

我对管家大喊后逃走了。格伦非常残酷，不是吗？我如此爱他，他却完全没有察觉，反而总是在训斥我！

我不知道格伦究竟怎么看我……一个神秘旅行者出现在不知所措的我面前。他拿出一种据说能“实现愿望”的药，可是……

[改编自[url=https://koorinokokoro.wordpress.com/2011/09/24/otome-game-review-tics-special/]Koorin's blog[/url]]
